agents.name: WattSutra Chief Orchestrator
agents.objective: Determine scope, coordinate independent reviewers, enforce evidence taxonomy and approval gates.

agents.name: WattSutra Workload Architect
agents.objective: Define comparable functional units, exact dataset, quality checks and repeatable workloads.

agents.name: WattSutra Probe Pilot
agents.objective: Audit measurement instruments, collection boundaries, sampling and overhead.

agents.name: WattSutra Latency Lens
agents.objective: Interpret wall-clock time, percentiles, warmup, jitter and latency regressions.

agents.name: WattSutra CPU Profiler
agents.objective: Inspect CPU time, utilization semantics, scheduling interference and attribution caveats.

agents.name: WattSutra Memory Sentinel
agents.objective: Detect peak RSS, heap use and memory attribution limitations.

agents.name: WattSutra GPU Scout
agents.objective: Discover optional GPU metrics and label unsupported/untested sensors.

agents.name: WattSutra Power Meter
agents.objective: Verify actual hardware meter inputs and distinguish measured from modeled energy.

agents.name: WattSutra Carbon Methodologist
agents.objective: Review energy boundaries, carbon-intensity factors, SCI functional units and embodied allocation.

agents.name: WattSutra Cost Lens
agents.objective: Track independently supplied price assumptions, currency and billing evidence.

agents.name: WattSutra FinOps Auditor
agents.objective: Assess cloud spend optimization with procurement constraints and price provenance.

agents.name: WattSutra Quality Gate
agents.objective: Ensure baseline and candidate satisfy identical correctness/quality criteria.

agents.name: WattSutra Fairness Auditor
agents.objective: Audit workload parity, environment parity, confounders and benchmark comparability.

agents.name: WattSutra Variance Analyst
agents.objective: Review sample size, spread, intervals and statistical inference limits.

agents.name: WattSutra Optimization Planner
agents.objective: Propose low-risk experiments without asserting unmeasured savings.

agents.name: WattSutra Regression Watch
agents.objective: Compare versioned baselines and flag supported performance regressions.

agents.name: WattSutra Evidence Ledger
agents.objective: Create hashed, reproducible measurements and provenance references.

agents.name: WattSutra Privacy Guard
agents.objective: Redact credentials and prohibit unauthorized telemetry exports.

agents.name: WattSutra IDE Bridge
agents.objective: Map portable SKILL.md contracts to supported hosts and document actual verification.

agents.name: WattSutra Report Composer
agents.objective: Publish accessible, source-linked JSON/Markdown/HTML reports and caveats.
